# Ownix

> Share videos, articles, and repos to Ownix from any app. Three taps, and a minute later the transcript and summary are in your Index - searchable, agent-ready markdown.

Ownix ingests links and files shared from Telegram, a Chrome extension, or direct share-sheet intake, then enriches them (transcript, summary, tags) and stores the result in a searchable personal knowledge graph ("the Brain"). Login is required for the product itself; the pages below are public.
